text:
deploy-bot: Planned soft-unpin window: runtime v3.4 -> v3.5 in us-west-1 starting 03:00 PT. Affected model-groups: dialogue-large, rerank-mini. Rollout 8% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Auto-pinback/rollback enabled. Playbook: https://go/redwood/ops/unpin-v3.5 :white_check_mark:

rachel: Quick question — does v3.5 change any routing headers? We still have some routes on sdk-3.0.

tom: Yes, v3.5 adds `x-rw-pref` rolling header. sdk-3.0 will 400 on that. We should exclude 3.0 from canary or shadow it. Also saw p95 +9% on dialogue-large at seq=1024 in perf lab.

yuan: New runtime emits `kv.swap.error` when KV layout mismatch occurs. If that spikes, first-token latency jumps and throughput drops until warm. Watch for that metric.

ops-runner: Ops checklist:
1) Start canary (8%) in us-west-1 and eu-central (5%)
2) Exclude sdk-3.0 routes: `route.exclude_if sdk_version ~ "^3\.0"`
3) Telemetry probes: latency.p95, kv.swap.error, errors, host.mem
4) Abort if p95 delta > 10% OR kv.swap.error > 0.1%
5) Rollback: `infractl rollback --runtime v3.5 --region us-west-1`
6) Pinback: `infractl pin --runtime v3.4 --model-group dialogue-large`

csm-bot: Please provide list of routes excluded/shadowed so we can notify affected CSMs.

deploy-bot: Exclude rule applied and shadow job started for sdk-3.0 traffic. Canary at 6881234010. Telemetry hooks attached.

tom: Canary update 6881234032 (us-west-1): dialogue-large p95 +11.2%, kv.swap.error 0.16%, mem +110MB. rerank-mini stable.

rachel: p95 > 10% and kv.swap.error above threshold. I recommend pinback for dialogue-large and continue rollout for rerank-mini.

yuan: Agreed. Pinback dialogue-large to v3.4, keep rerank-mini moving to 25% but with stricter p95 gate (7%).

ops-runner: Actioning pinback: `infractl pin --runtime v3.4 --model-group dialogue-large --region us-west-1` at 6881234040. Rolling rerank-mini to 25% at 6881234045.

csm-bot: Excluded route list posted to #private-csm. Drafted customer note for the 6 affected SDK-3.0 routes.

deploy-bot: Final: rollout paused for dialogue-large (pinned back). rerank-mini continues. To abort entire rollout reply `abort` or run `deploy-bot pause 6881234000`. Please file any postmortem if kv.swap.error resurges after re-run.
